pat_sdk: Quick report from sampleapp QA: when prefetch >1 and token refresh fails once then succeeds, we either see a long stall or a short burst of Generate calls depending on SDK. reproducible with flaky STS.
ivy_swe: can you paste a small repro and logs?
pat_sdk: minimal flow: pager prefetch=3, Generate() can trigger Token.refresh() which is blocking in some SDKs. when refresh retries, pager keeps filling queue. after refresh succeeds backlog fires and backend returns 429.
pat_sdk: log snippet:
[09:00:10] pager: queued page 4
[09:00:10] token: refresh start
[09:00:11] pager: queued page 5
[09:00:11] token: refresh success
[09:00:11] client: concurrent=7 (limit=3)
[09:00:11] backend: 429 burst
ichris_doc: proposed short fixes: lower sampleapp prefetch to 1, add troubleshooting note in quickstart, and add an integration test that simulates STS flakiness. medium fix: make token refresh non-blocking or yield after refresh on sync SDKs.
ivy_swe: i'll open a PR to adjust sampleapp default and add the repro + README. pat, can you file a DEVEX ticket with logs?
ci-bot: created DEVEX-1337 "prefetch-auth-backpressure-onboarding"
pat_sdk: filed and linked logs. thanks all.
